capabilities: fold the properties panel by default
toggle unfolded properties back to folded state
extras: Has no settings; it works by calling Obsidian's built-in fold command when properties are detected unfolded.
intentEvidence: I think this should be implemented as a built-in option, but for the time being, I came up with a simple way
motivation: The author saw requests on the official forums for default-folded properties and wanted that behavior before it becomes a built-in option.
problem: Obsidian opens the properties panel unfolded by default and offers no built-in option to have it folded.
summary: Automatically folds the metadata properties panel whenever a note is opened, keeping frontmatter collapsed by default.
